title: Dutch fintech Bunq applies to become a US bank; the OCC conditionally approved national trust bank charters for several crypto firms in 2025, including Circle (Paige Smith/Bloomberg)
summary: Paige Smith / Bloomberg: Dutch fintech Bunq applies to become a US bank; the OCC conditionally approved national trust bank charters for several crypto firms in 2025, including Circle — The Dutch fintech Bunq BV applied to become a US bank two years after rescinding a previous application under former President Joe Biden.
